role: Pointer from the historical prepared packet to the evidence of its execution. It is not itself an execution receipt, and it does not modify the packet.
added_by: ASM manual edition 2, for PR85 reviewer note NB1

prepared_packet.status_note: The status recorded when the packet was prepared. The packet is kept unchanged as the historical record of preparation; the execution below does not rewrite it.

execution.scope: legacy synthetic recipe/refit parity and separate legacy pipeline; no fitted-export qualification

receipts.role: execution result: every command, exit status, versions, artifacts and counts
stopped audit: counts, declared limits, measurements and scope exclusions
handoff: SHA-256 of the run's receipt files, including the controller, allocation, inputs, journal, result and audit

custody.note: Host-local private custody outside Git. Its HANDOFF.json, audit.json and result.json are byte-identical to the copies above; it also retains the controller, the allocation, the journal and every command's output.
